junit_receipt.public_report_policy: Actual outcomes, class names, base test names and durations. Captured output, traces and properties excluded. Every parameter literal replaced by its SHA-256 to keep private paths and credential test strings out of the public report.

scope: Separately preserved developmental scoped report. Execution global source identity was not recorded in this JUnit; it is not invented here. Counts overlap the complete repository suite and must not be summed as independent coverage.
